name: Cask Solid Sheesham Wood Fold-Out Bar Cabinet with Wine Rack

description.mood_line: Compact elegance meets the art of the pour.
description.intro: The Cask Bar Cabinet presents a slender, vertical silhouette designed to anchor a dining corner with refined social utility.
description.story: Crafted from solid sheesham wood in a deep mahogany finish, the unit features antique brass hardware that complements its sturdy, splayed base. When opened, the cabinet reveals a 1.70-meter span housing dedicated stemware hanging rails, a 16-bottle wine rack, and a fold-out cocktail prep surface for effortless service.
description.close: This piece grounds the space with stable vertical poise, transforming daily breakfasts into moments of curated hospitality.

name: Harbor Swivel Counter Stool with Integrated Footrest

description.mood_line: Gather at sunrise, where sleek ash meets soft leather for effortless counter conversation.
description.intro: The Harbor stool presents a refined circular silhouette, marrying solid ash wood legs with a tan leatherette seat.
description.story: Crafted from solid ash with a warm walnut veneer, the stool’s 46 cm diameter base supports a 65 cm counter‑height seat upholstered in supple tan leatherette. A silent ball‑bearing swivel offers smooth 360° movement, while the integrated circular brass footrest provides ergonomic support for relaxed mornings. Its compact footprint and splayed wooden legs deliver steady poise on any kitchen island.
description.close: Its poised presence anchors the breakfast island, inviting intimate moments around the kitchen’s heart.
